name: the solar neighbourhood
plain: Twenty-nine stars at their catalogue directions and distances (Hipparcos and RECONS values, rounded to 0.01 degrees and three figures, entered by hand): the named systems within 12 light years and the brightest out to 140; each stands on a stem from the plane, with rings at 1, 10 and 100 light years. Neptune's orbit and the edge of the Sun's wind where Voyager 1 crossed it (121 au) are measured. The Oort cloud (2,000 to 100,000 au) has never been observed: its points are an illustration. Star sizes are not to scale.

carrier.state: twenty-nine stars at catalogue directions and distances

basis.note: 'How the rungs meet': each scene moves its own origin and frame with z, so that at the shared edge the two draw the same thing in the same place

parts.what: the Oort cloud's points, 2,000 to 100,000 au: never observed

source.external: RECONS, the Research Consortium On Nearby Stars: the nearest star systems

budget.quantity: what drawing a tile coarse may move against drawing it fine: the draw allocator's tolerance (Acuity, eps_px). It is not a bound on the picture's faithfulness to the holon.
